title: SIDESTORY: SUCH IS THE JOY OF OUR REUNION
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: SUCH IS THE JOY OF OUR REUNION OPEN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Such is the Joy of Our Reunion event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
- Phase 1 「Flavor of Food」
DURATION: July 17, 2025, 10:00 - August 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 2 「Flavor of Life」
DURATION: July 24, 2025, 16:00 - August 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 3 「Farewell, Loved Ones」
DURATION: July 31, 2025, 16:00 - August 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[ Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture ]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Xingzhu], Ding Feng Lou Teahouse Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, 'Yum-yum!', etc.
[Savors at Yu's]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain 'Yum-yum!' by clearing event stages and completing [Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture]. 'Yum-yum!' can be used to redeem items from [Savors at Yu's].

REWARDS: Xingzhu's tokens, Ding Feng Lou Teahouse Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, 0011 Collection - Healing Hand, Evil Heart for Aak, EPOQUE Collection - Unknown Journey for Gitano, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – AN ETERNITY AFLAME
DETAILS: During the Limited-time Headhunting, [An Eternity Aflame], the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Yu [Limited] / Blaze the Igniting Spark
★★★★★★: Shu [Limited] / Chongyue [Limited] / Ling [Limited]
★★★★★: Surfer

In this [Limited Headhunting], players will get the limited Operator Yu after a total of 300 rolls (once only) . This special 6-star Operator is a bonus gift that does not give [Headhunting Data Contracts], and does not affect the chance to get next 6-star Operator in this [Limited Headhunting]. This count is reset at the end of this [Limited Headhunting].
NOTE:
- [An Eternity Aflame] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Festival] headhunting series.
- [Limited Headhunting - Festival] is Limited Headhunting.
- Blaze the Igniting Spark and Surfer will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after July 31, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Operator Yu is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Festival], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.

- Operator Nian will be available in the [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] during [Limited Headhunting - Festival]. The required Headhunting Data Contracts for Nian will be reduced from 300 to 200 starting this headhunting.
Available Operators from the current [Headhunting Data Contract Shop]:
★★★★★★ (300 Headhunting Data Contract): Yu / Blaze the Igniting Spark / Shu / Chongyue / Ling / Dusk
★★★★★★ (200 Headhunting Data Contract): Nian
★★★★★ (75 Headhunting Data Contract): Surfer
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 AN ETERNITY AFLAME LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: Players can log in during the event to claim reward on event page: A Pleasant Banquet Headhunting Permit * 1
NOTE:
- A Pleasant Banquet Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [An Eternity Aflame] Limited Headhunting.
- A Pleasant Banquet Headhunting Permit expires on July 31, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
04 DAILY FREE ROLL IN [AN ETERNITY AFLAME] LIMITED HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [An Eternity Aflame] Limited Headhunting.
NOTE:
- Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day.
- Daily Free Roll can only be used once a day and will not accumulate.
05 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
★★★★★★: Yu [Limited]
★★★★★★: Blaze the Igniting Spark
★★★★★: Surfer
★★★★★: Xingzhu
DETAILS:
- Yu is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Festival], and is NOT available in any [Standard Headhunting].

- Operator Xingzhu is currently ONLY available from Such is the Joy of Our Reunion event, and is NOT available in [An Eternity Aflame] Limited Headhunting, [Standard Headhunting] or [Kernel Headhunting].
- Operators Blaze the Igniting Spark and Surfer will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after July 31, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- From July 17, 2025, 10:00 to August 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7), Operators Yu, Blaze the Igniting Spark, Surfer, and Xingzhu will gain more trust in the event stages.
06 LUNGMEN LUCKY STRIPS OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Lucky Strips each day upon login. Consume trials to select Lucky Strips as permitted in [Lungmen Lucky Strips]. The Lucky Strip with the most Orundum will be awarded. Both trials for the day must be used before claiming the reward.
NOTE:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Lucky Strips.
- Players will randomly obtain following amount of Orundum from Lucky Strips:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) on the next day and cannot be accumulated.

11 RHODES ISLAND HEADHUNTING PACK AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
Rhodes Island Headhunting Pack (Limited to 2 purchases)
CONTENTS: Players need to choose one option from the following when purchasing this Headhunting pack:
Type-α Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Surtr, Mudrock, and Bagpipe)
Type-β Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Reed the Flame Shadow, Goldenglow, and Kal'tsit)
Type-γ Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Typhon, Executor the Ex Foedere, and Jessica the Liberated)

Players will receive the chosen custom headhunting permit upon purchase. The selected permit can be used to perform a [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting] that guarantees one random 6-star Operator from its pool.
[Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting]:
- You may select only one of the Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permits and purchase only twice. This choice is final and cannot be changed after purchase.

- The permit is good for [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting]. For this headhunting, the number of rolls without a 6-star Operator will not be accumulated or applied to any [Standard Headhunting], and will remain separate from any accumulated rolls on other [Standard Headhuntings].

- For this Headhunting, players are guaranteed to receive a 6-star Operator when performing a 10-roll. The available pool of 6-star Operators is the same for every player, and depends on the [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting] pool chosen.
NOTE:
- Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permit expires at: September 4, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- You may only use this Headhunting Permit once. Upon use, its Headhunting pool will automatically be removed.
- If not used by the expiration date, this Headhunting Permit will be removed from your Depot, so please make sure to use it before it expires.
Aside from a guaranteed 6-star Operator from the selected Headhunting Permit, the pull rates for the [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting] are as follows:
★6 Operator: 2%
★5 Operator: 8%
★4 Operator: 50%
★3 Operator: 40%
Rhodes Island Special Pack
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 51, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, Orundum * 2100, Module Data Block * 4

DETAILS: During the event period, players can receive gift emails from different Operators at various time intervals.
ELIGIBILITY: Players who registered and named the Doctor before July 17, 2025, 20:00 (UTC-7).
NOTES:
- The details of the gifts and the email delivery will be determined based on the actual event.
- The event emails will be valid for 7 days. Please remember to claim them in time.
18 2025 FESTIVAL SIGN-IN

DETAILS: During the event period, players can log in on July 17, July 20, July 23, and July 26 to receive specific Operator blessings along with a certain amount of Orundum. The received blessings can be added to players' own collection of Blessings. Additionally, the Operator blessings can be shared or saved as wallpapers. Players can log in for a total of 10 days to receive event-exclusive Furniture, Module Materials, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, among other rewards.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Chip Catalyst * 1, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 4: Strategic Battle Record * 10, Sugar Pack * 3
Day 5: LMD * 30000, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 6: Skill Summary - 3 * 8, Crystalline Component * 3
Day 7: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, Pure Gold * 20
Day 8: Exclusive Furniture - 'Lucky Sugar Painting Display' * 1, Furniture Part * 300
Day 9: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Orirock Cluster * 3
Day 10: Module Data Block * 1, Skill Summary - 1 * 30
NOTE:
- Each Operator blessing can be obtained only once.
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
Please stay tuned for more information!
